description: This file declares the 'ReportPosition' class, which is a task related to reporting the position in a media player context within the Rialto server's generic tasks namespace. It includes class members, constructor, destructor, and an execute method, and references several external interfaces and context classes.

classes.name: ReportPosition
classes.description: A class representing a task to report the current position in a media playback context, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: ReportPosition
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ReportPosition task with the given context, client, and GST wrapper.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to report the current position.
